prompt: Why does (Clara / cat) ignore its soft bed and sleep inside an empty box?
explanation_ru: Для обозначения принадлежности человеку используется притяжательный падеж с апострофом и -s: Clara's cat.

prompt: Please lock the (door / your shed) and don't leave spare keys under mats.
explanation_ru: Для частей неодушевлённых предметов обычно используется конструкция с предлогом of: the door of your shed.

prompt: Are all those (tourists / bikes) blocking my driveway near the yellow sunflowers?
explanation_ru: У существительного во множественном числе, оканчивающегося на -s (tourists), притяжательный падеж образуется одним апострофом после -s: tourists' bikes.

prompt: We laughed when we found (Dad / orange shirt) inside an old loft suitcase.
explanation_ru: Для одушевлённого владельца в единственном числе используется притяжательная форма с 's: Dad's orange shirt.

prompt: Before the (start / the film), Riku tried to add sweet potatoes to (his sister / snack list) of rice crackers and tea.
explanation_ru: С неодушевлённым понятием (film) используется предлог of (the start of the film), а с человеком — притяжательное 's (his sister's snack list).

prompt: Chloe emailed to say she found a (customer / striped scarf) and a soup box near the (leg / the table).
explanation_ru: Принадлежность человеку передаётся через 's (a customer's striped scarf), а часть неодушевлённого предмета — через of (the leg of the table).

prompt: At the wedding in Rotorua, a close (friend / he) accidentally brought (his aunt / heavy dish) instead of the clock.
explanation_ru: В конструкции двойного притяжательного падежа после of ставится абсолютная форма местоимения (a friend of his), а для родственника в единственном числе — 's (his aunt's heavy dish).

prompt: Could every member check the (seniors / timetable) on the hall door so nobody forgets a light towel and water?
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о расписании для всех пожилых участников (множественное число на -s), поэтому апостроф ставится после -s: seniors' timetable.

prompt: A polite sign at the (front / the hotel) asks that all (guests / muddy shoes) stay outside the quiet lobby.
explanation_ru: Часть здания передаётся через of (the front of the hotel), а обувь многих гостей — через множественное притяжательное на -s' (guests' muddy shoes).

prompt: Halfway through (Tomasz / online interview) in Poznan, his father walked past holding a noisy blender right in the (middle / the video call).
explanation_ru: К имени человека в единственном числе добавляется 's (Tomasz's online interview), а с неодушевлённым событием используется предлог of (the middle of the video call).

prompt: Only minutes before tuning began in Weimar, Ulrike realised she hadn't taken her music stand from (her brother / van), which was parked beside the (side / the hall).
explanation_ru: Владелец-человек оформляется через 's (her brother's van), а сторона здания — с помощью конструкции с of (the side of the hall).

prompt: Before spring break in St. Gallen, the caretaker sent an ironic note to the (parents / committee) because sixteen lonely right boots were still filling the (children / cloakroom).
explanation_ru: К правильному множественному числу parents добавляется только апостроф (parents' committee), а к неправильному children без -s на конце — полное 's (children's cloakroom).

prompt: I live next door to Tessa and Carlos. Yesterday, a delivery driver mixed up our parcels on the front porch. Tessa opened (Carlos / big sack) of bird food by mistake. Later, that funny (neighbour / we) brought back her tiny parcel of silver buttons.
explanation_ru: К имени в единственном числе на -s обычно добавляется 's (Carlos's, допустимо и Carlos'), а после указательного that используется двойной притяжательный падеж с абсолютным местоимением (neighbour of ours).

prompt: Rain fell hard at our quiet village bus stop in Carlow. Suddenly, (my aunt / basket) slipped from her wet hands. Round potatoes rolled right into the (middle / the road). Our kind bus driver stopped at once and picked up every single one.
explanation_ru: Корзина тёти передаётся через 's (my aunt's basket), а середина дороги — через неодушевлённую конструкцию с of (the middle of the road).

prompt: Ivana was wrapping framed drawings in a quiet Prague studio when she noticed a shiny mess on the table. The (lid / the tin) of gold powder had come loose inside (Ivana / apron) pocket. She couldn't stop laughing as the plain brown paper started to sparkle. Fortunately, a helpful (colleague / she) brought a soft brush and saved the whole stack.
explanation_ru: Для части предмета нужна конструкция с of (the lid of the tin), для владельца-человека — 's (Ivana's apron), а для значения «одна из её коллег» — двойной притяжательный падеж (a colleague of hers).

prompt: Have you seen the striped river stone that went missing from (Neville / cabinet) in Palmerston North? He searched every drawer and didn't find a single clue until lunchtime. While making coffee in the (workers / tea room), he spotted the heavy stone holding up the (frame / the window). Nobody knew who had put it there, though the room certainly felt cooler.
explanation_ru: Имя владельца требует 's (Neville's cabinet), комната для многих сотрудников — апострофа после -s (workers' tea room), а часть окна — предлога of (the frame of the window).

prompt: I spent three hours carrying heavy history books across our crowded campus library in Krakow. Most of the (students / desks) were full, so I felt lucky to grab a quiet seat at the (back / the room). When I stepped out to buy cold water, a cheeky (classmate / I) moved my pile and sat down. I wasn't even gone for five minutes!
explanation_ru: Множественное число на -s принимает только апостроф (students' desks), часть помещения оформляется через of (the back of the room), а «один из моих однокурсников» — через двойной притяжательный падеж (a classmate of mine).

prompt: Dear Manager, I am writing because someone tore open three (residents / parcels) beside the mailboxes in our Montreal block. Empty cardboard boxes were scattered across the (floor / the lobby), yet the main glass door wasn't damaged at all. An angry (neighbour / I) even lost a birthday gift that had arrived earlier that morning. Could you check the camera footage near the lift and let us know what happened? Best regards, Farid.
explanation_ru: Посылки нескольких жильцов оформляются через s' (residents' parcels), часть помещения — через of (the floor of the lobby), а «один из моих соседей» — через двойной притяжательный падеж (a neighbour of mine).

prompt: Two hours before (Lea and Hugo / wedding) in Avignon, the delivery driver braked hard and tipped a whole tray of lemon tarts. Several pastries slid straight off the (edge / the tray) onto the clean van floor. Lea phoned her mother in panic, although a calm (cousin / she) stayed at the shop and helped the baker pull a fresh batch from the oven. Nobody among the eighty guests ever suspected that the dessert had nearly been ruined.
explanation_ru: При общей принадлежности 's ставится только ко второму имени (Lea and Hugo's wedding), край подноса передаётся через of (the edge of the tray), а «одна из её кузин» — через двойной притяжательный падеж (a cousin of hers).

prompt: In our kitchen, ___ ignored its new tower and slept in a basket.
explanation_ru: С именем владельца используется форма с 's без артикля the перед именем (Phoebe's grey cat). Типичные ошибки — калька с of (the cat of Phoebe) или лишний артикль the.

prompt: Before his evening flight, Nabil carefully checked ___ at the airport spice kiosk.
options: the gift list of his wife
explanation_ru: Принадлежность человеку в единственном числе передаётся с помощью 's (his wife's gift list), а не через громоздкую конструкцию с of или лишний артикль the.

prompt: Yoko placed a wooden sign beside the sliding door showing where all ___ should dry on rainy afternoons.
explanation_ru: Слово all указывает на многих гостей, поэтому нужен апостроф после множественного -s: the guests' umbrellas. Ошибка — ставить апостроф перед -s (guest's) или менять порядок слов.

prompt: Anja taped an ironic notice beside the reception desk in Leuven after the broken scanner rejected ___ yet politely unlocked the door for the delivery driver's dog.
explanation_ru: Неопределённое местоимение everyone стоит в единственном числе и образует притяжательную форму с 's (everyone's key cards), а существительное во множественном числе cards апострофа не требует.

prompt: Stefan borrowed the small charger of his colleague on the busy Munich train.
answer: Stefan borrowed his colleague's small charger on the busy Munich train.
accepted_answers: Stefan borrowed his colleague's small charger on the busy Munich train.
explanation_ru: Если владелец — человек, в английском используется притяжательный падеж с 's (his colleague's small charger), а не калька с предлогом of.

prompt: Istvan joked in our group chat that weekend drivers always block the field's wooden gate only to film purple flowers.
answer: Istvan joked in our group chat that weekend drivers always block the wooden gate of the field only to film purple flowers.
accepted_answers: Istvan joked in our group chat that weekend drivers always block the wooden gate of the field only to film purple flowers.
explanation_ru: Для частей неодушевлённых объектов (field) вместо 's используется конструкция с предлогом of: the wooden gate of the field.

prompt: Ruta recognised her great-aunt's handmade linen tablecloth behind the display glass and invited her whole family on Saturday.
answer: Ruta recognised her great-aunt's handmade linen tablecloth behind the display glass and invited her whole family on Saturday.
accepted_answers: Ruta recognised her great-aunt's handmade linen tablecloth behind the display glass and invited her whole family on Saturday.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: у составного существительного great-aunt в единственном числе притяжательное окончание 's правильно стоит в конце слова.

prompt: A clear notice on the Toronto lecture door explains where all the student's coats and heavy bags must stay during the morning exam.
answer: A clear notice on the Toronto lecture door explains where all the students' coats and heavy bags must stay during the morning exam.
accepted_answers: A clear notice on the Toronto lecture door explains where all the students' coats and heavy bags must stay during the morning exam.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о вещах всех студентов (all), поэтому нужно множественное число с апострофом после -s: all the students' coats, а не student's.

prompt: Brenda lives in flat 4 and Neil lives in flat 5, and each of them ordered a different parcel. Which sentence describes the mix-up accurately?
options: The courier mixed up Brenda and Neil's parcels outside their doors.
The courier mixed up Brenda's and Neil's parcels outside their doors.
The courier mixed up the parcels of Brenda and of Neil outside their doors.
The courier mixed up Brendas' and Neils' parcels outside their doors.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идёт о раздельной принадлежности (у каждого своя посылка), окончание 's ставится к каждому имени: Brenda's and Neil's parcels.

prompt: Callum runs a small repair shop in Glasgow, and one of his regular customers arrived carrying a wet phone buried inside a large plastic tub of uncooked rice. Which sentence sounds natural and grammatically correct?
options: A regular customer of Callum's brought a wet phone buried inside a plastic tub of rice.
A regular customer of Callum brought a wet phone buried inside a rice's plastic tub.
Callum's a regular customer brought a wet phone buried inside a plastic tub of rice.
A regular Callum's customer brought a wet phone buried inside a plastic tub of rice.
explanation_ru: Для значения «один из постоянных клиентов Каллума» используется двойной притяжательный падеж (a regular customer of Callum's), а для содержимого ёмкости — предлог of (a plastic tub of rice).

prompt: Because one of my colleagues keeps hiding the striped spoon that belongs to Fabio behind the kettle, he taped a playful riddle onto the office fridge. → Because a colleague …
answer: Because a colleague of mine keeps hiding Fabio's striped spoon behind the kettle, he taped a playful riddle onto the office fridge.
accepted_answers: Because a colleague of mine keeps hiding Fabio's striped spoon behind the kettle, he taped a playful riddle onto the office fridge.
explanation_ru: Оборот «один из моих коллег» заменяется на двойной притяжательный падеж a colleague of mine, а принадлежность ложки Фабио — на Fabio's striped spoon.
